interpretation.basis: Both primary point estimates favor semantic features. Macro pairwise improves by 0.042791 with 95% CI [0.029331, 0.056130]; mean regret changes by -0.001553 with CI [-0.004263, 0.001361]. Every leave-one-fold-out aggregate preserves both favorable directions. REWARDS (765/1024 decisions), the largest natural family, drives the overall ranking gain; removing it leaves no established pairwise advantage. This is not one tiny family or fold. No overall regret penalty was observed, but regret improvement and formal noninferiority are not established: no numerical meaningful-harm margin was prespecified, and the interval allows up to 0.00136 Q-unit worsening (about 4.7% of primitive mean regret). Classification is an explicit qualitative application of the handoff, not a formal no-harm test.
interpretation.independent_interpretation_review: KEEP with the stated mixture, regret-uncertainty, and family limitations.
qualifications: SHOP (56 decisions) favors semantic in both primary point estimates, but both family intervals cross zero; the prior weakness was not reproduced, not definitively reversed.
EVENT (68 decisions) is an adverse exploratory slice: semantic regret is higher by 0.013011 and pairwise lower by 0.042783, with both intervals crossing zero.
The 127 compound-containing decisions have lower semantic mean regret by 0.010999 (95% CI [-0.021706,-0.001858]); siblings remain one scientific decision.
SELECTOR (8) and BOSS_RELIC (16) remain sparse; family intervals are descriptive and uncorrected for multiplicity.
Pairwise comparison covers 964 decisions with defined ordering; 60 decisions have fully tied truth labels.
No production model was trained or exported; only the prespecified fixed representation probes were fitted offline. No combat predictor was trained.
interpretation.scope: Frozen-probe ranking on this fresh, naturally reward-dominated 1024-decision cohort; no production-policy or all-family superiority claim.

limitations: No prespecified meaningful-harm or null-equivalence margin; uncertain cases remain comparable.
Family and fold bootstrap intervals are descriptive, with no multiplicity correction.
State-only top-1/top-or-tied/regret depend on row-order tie breaking; pairwise 0.5 is its ranking null.
Leave-out sensitivity removes held-out groups without refitting models.
Only fresh confirmation groups enter fitting or primary inference; no development groups are pooled.
